disposition.target: Build pipeline replay gate configuration (DevOps team)
disposition.change: Replay one recorded history per acceptance path of the reference fixture, keep them with the contract jar, and take the MSG-P3-038 text from the message catalogue before the gate is mandatory.
disposition.note: The replay gate is not named in this story; the corpus and message text belong to the pipeline and message catalogue. No story edit.

disposition.target: AsyncAPI schema of rwb.decision-record.v1 and OpenAPI of the two decision-log operations (wave 2 design review)
disposition.change: Publish the payload of DecisionRecorded, the ingest columns of decision_log_entry and the three message texts; the story keeps the assumed shape of ASM-B-P7-05-E2043-1 until then.
disposition.note: Section 3 already states the payload is not specified and holds the assumed shape. The payload itself is set outside this story.

disposition.change: Publish the five-minute collection target and the 02:00 chain-check time as named parameters with a version and owner; the ledger reads them at the version in force on the business date.
disposition.note: Section 3 already reads both through the parameters client with no default in code. The parameter rows belong to rwb-case.

disposition.change: Parent starts each child with the case ID, retries the start with the same workflow ID, and raises an incident with MSG-P3-037 when retries are exhausted, leaving the case in its last applied state.
disposition.note: Child workflows belong to the rwb-case workflow. This story adds no workflow (section 3), so no story edit.

disposition.change: A pivot activity waits on the ledger acknowledgement with the retry policy of section 7 and a documented timeout, and fails with an incident at timeout without repeating a completed step.
disposition.note: The pivot wait sits in the producing saga's workflow, not in this ledger story. No story edit.

disposition.change: TC-E2-043-07 covers AC6, BR8, BR11, BR15, aligned with Test Cases v8.
disposition.note: Aligned to v8. AC8 now has no test case in section 16 and needs a ruling or a new test case.

disposition.change: Align the test lists of the four requirements with section 18 of this story in the next RTM version.
disposition.note: The proposed fix moves the alignment into the next RTM version. Section 18 is unchanged.
